Optimal.Notes: Setting the refresh rate to 40 Hz and capping at 40 fps gives perfectly smooth, tear-free gameplay with good visual fidelity; this is the sweet spot for Warframe on the Deck. FSR upscaling from 1024x640 keeps the GPU comfortable while textures remain sharp.

profiles.Summary: Warframe runs well on the Steam Deck under Proton, with the game being Steam Deck Verified and ProtonDB trending platinum — most players report a smooth experience with minimal tweaking. The game is a free-to-play online action title with moderate PC requirements that the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU handles comfortably at medium-to-high settings.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from Warframe's PC minimum requirements (roughly GTX 960-class GPU), the Deck's RDNA 2 hardware capability, and its Verified status with a strong platinum ProtonDB trend. On first launch, check frame rates in an open-world zone (Plains of Eidolon) — that is the most demanding area — and adjust settings downward if the Optimal profile dips below 35 fps.

MaxBattery.Notes: Dropping render resolution to 960x600 with FSR upscaling and a 7 W TDP cap significantly extends battery life; 30 fps feels smooth for this third-person action game. In-game option names are approximated from Warframe's known PC settings menu — verify exact names on first launch.

KnownIssues: No native Linux client — runs entirely through Proton/DirectX 11 emulation layer
Online-only requirement means no offline play; connection issues may affect session stability
In-app purchases and login screens may occasionally require mouse/keyboard input via the on-screen keyboard
Some players report occasional shader compilation stutters on first launch or after updates

MaxPerformance.Notes: At full 1280x800 with high settings and no TDP limit, Warframe generally holds 50-60 fps in most missions, but hectic open-world zones (Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis) may dip to the mid-40s. Battery drain will be significant at 15 W; plug in or use this profile for shorter sessions.

Optimal.Notes: This profile holds 60 fps in most standard missions and Relays; expect drops to 45-50 fps in busy Landscape open-world zones. Disabling Ambient Occlusion and Motion Blur recovers meaningful GPU headroom.

profiles.Summary: Warframe runs well on the Steam Deck via Proton, with its free-to-play online action gameplay translating smoothly to the handheld at medium-to-high settings. The game's relatively modest PC requirements mean the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU can handle it comfortably, though busy open-world Landscapes and large squad missions can cause frame dips.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from Warframe's modest PC minimum requirements (roughly GTX 960-class GPU minimum) against the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU performance tier. On first run, check frame stability in a busy Landscape zone — that is the hardest scenario — and drop to the Optimal profile if you see sustained dips below 45 fps.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling keeps the GPU load minimal; the 7 W TDP limit is the primary battery lever. Landscape zones may still dip briefly even at these settings.

KnownIssues: No native Linux client — runs through Proton only, which is well-supported but adds a small overhead.
Launcher may require interaction on first launch; some users report needing to complete updates through the launcher before the game starts.
Large open-world Landscape zones (Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis, Cambion Drift) are significantly more demanding than standard missions and may drop frames.
In-app purchases and account login require an active internet connection; offline play is not supported.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Native 1280x800 at high settings is sustainable in standard missions and Dojos; Landscape zones will pull the frame rate down to 45-60 fps. Battery drain will be high — best used while plugged in.
